Hi Glen,

I saw you take a funnel‑oriented view of the client journey—lead to opportunity, win, implementation, go‑live, ramp, and then a sticky client—while tuning each handoff to boost the revenue engine. It sounds like gaining clear, consistent metrics across those stages can be a challenge. Our platform lets operations teams automate the manual, reconciliation‑heavy steps that often cause those visibility gaps, freeing your team to focus on value‑adding activities.

Would you be open to a quick call to explore?

Zamp
